verdict.line: You lose if you walk into a ready Flawless Duet and eat the stun into a Bladesurge chain; you win if you strike while her E is down and lean on Q's yank plus W's attack-speed burst.

brief.thesis: Irelia's entire threat window is gated behind E (Flawless Duet), a 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown that stuns and Marks anything caught between the converging blades — outside that window she has no hard engage beyond Q (Bladesurge) dashes. Kled's own cooldowns (Q 11-7s, E 13-9s) are short enough to punish every gap, which is exactly why this matchup runs 56.4% over 78 games with both lane and solo-kill advantage on Kled's side.

theirWindow.when: Flawless Duet ready near max Ionian Fervor stacks
theirWindow.what: She can stun-Mark you, then Bladesurge in for free refreshed-cooldown damage with bonus on-hit from her passive. Back off or bait it with Skaarl's body, not yours.

yourWindow.when: her E (Flawless Duet) was just used or missed
yourWindow.what: Hook with Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) to yank her in, pop W (Violent Tendencies) for the four empowered attacks, and trade freely — she has nothing to punish the engage with until E comes back.

start.why: Most-picked start in this matchup (84.4% pick, 48.1% WR over 81 games) — the extra sustain and on-hit damage matter because you're trading autos through her passive stacks, not kiting.

boots.why: Overwhelmingly the pick here (83.7% pick, 50% WR over 72 games) — Irelia's damage is almost entirely auto-attack and on-hit from Ionian Fervor, so flat physical reduction blunts every stack she builds.

core.why: The dominant first core item (appears in every listed path) — the AoE slam scales off your max HP and feeds Skaarl's remount sustain in extended trades.

Pairs with Titanic Hydra in the top two build paths (40% WR, 18.9% pick; also the 50% WR Overlord's Bloodmail line) — the armor shred cuts through anything she buys to shrug off your empowered W autos.
Closes out the highest-sample core path (40% WR over 10 games) — the shield and AD scaling keep you alive through a Bladesurge reset chain if she catches you off-cooldown.

runes.keystoneWhy: The default keystone on this build (34% pick) — Kled vs Irelia is a prolonged-trade matchup where both sides land multiple autos per engage, and Conqueror's stacking damage rewards staying in range through her passive stacks rather than poking once and leaving.

summoners.why: The most-picked combo in this matchup (67% pick) — Ignite punishes her Bladesurge heal directly, and Flash covers the gap if she lands the Flawless Duet stun. Exhaust+Flash (50% WR, 19.2% pick) is the alternative if you'd rather neuter her damage mid-stun than guarantee the kill.

playing.title: Trade only when her E is down
playing.detail: Hook with Q and pop W the moment Flawless Duet is on cooldown. That's your entire green light — don't force it while she still has the stun up.

playing.title: Dash through the stun, don't tank it
playing.detail: Use E (Jousting) to reposition out of where her two converging blades are about to meet. Getting caught between them is what turns a fair trade into a dead laner.

playing.title: Count Ionian Fervor stacks
playing.detail: Her passive stacks bonus attack speed per spell hit and adds on-hit damage at max stacks — disengage before she's fully stacked rather than after.

playing.title: Expect the Bladesurge reset
playing.detail: If you're Marked or low, her Q (Bladesurge) cooldown refreshes on hit or kill. A trade that looks over can chain into a second dash — don't walk away at half health assuming it's done.

playing.title: Remember your kit swaps on dismount
playing.detail: Once Skaarl's health runs out, Q becomes Pocket Pistol (a knockback blast on yourself, no hook). Don't throw for a Q yank you no longer have while dismounted.

playing.title: Save R for a committed fight, not a poke
playing.detail: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is on a 140-110s cooldown — use it to force a kill in the 3-5 or 9-13 level windows where you already have the cooldown edge, not to contest a 50/50 skirmish.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, and win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the cooldown/range breakdowns and the tactical reasoning connecting them to this matchup are my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Use Jousting [E] to avoid Irelia’s Flawless Duet (E). Keep an eye out on Irelia’s Ionian Fervor (P) and Conqueror stacks before initiating combat.
